transcript.text: Hi everyone. We've got one ADR pickup session needed for the lead actor before the final mix. The draft plan is a six-hour session in Stage 1 on October 21, but before I make a binding decision on the booking, I need to run through our normal finalization routine — checking in with the sound, talent, and legal leads. Let's start working through that so we can lock this down.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a problem with the draft plan. Yesterday after the mix review I ran an acoustic test and found a persistent HVAC resonance in Stage 1 right in the lead actor's vocal range. Stage 3 is the only approved alternative, and the ADR files need to be recorded at 96 kHz, not the 48 kHz that's in the current draft. I haven't entered any of this in the booking sheet yet because the test report is still being signed off.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical on the talent side. I confirmed with the actor's agent this morning that the lead actor is only available for ADR on October 24, from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. That means the maximum usable booking is a four-hour session, not the six hours in the draft plan. The October 21 date in the current draft won't work at all. I haven't had a chance to add the agent's email to the shared production calendar yet, but this is confirmed availability.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical legal constraint I just discovered. I received the executed performer side letter today — I haven't uploaded it to the production file yet — but it contains two hard requirements that directly impact our session plan. First, this ADR pickup must be a closed, in-person session: no remote participants and no observers allowed. Second, no scratch or rough recordings may be retained after the approved ADR files are delivered; everything else must be deleted. So whatever Stage and date we settle on, the booking and our internal protocols need to account for both of these restrictions.
transcript.speaker: A4
